name: Hakam
description: Partnership trick-taking for 4, 6 or 8 players. The first player who can't follow suit sets the Hakam. Win more than half the hands.

name: Ka-Chu-Phu-La
description: Bid how many hands you will win, then win exactly that many. 16 rounds for 2 to 6 players, with a new Hakam every round.

name: Mindi
description: Partnership trick-taking for 4, 6 or 8 players. Capture the 10s: win most of them to win the game.

name: Template Game
description: Starting point for new games. Drag the card, tap the background.
